title: Validate scene elements against rounded content regions
description: Validate authoritative shared-scene geometry, including nested and overlay content, against each derived rounded content region and return stable assignment- and element-specific violations.
acceptanceCriteria: Validation consumes the authoritative normalized scene rather than DOM, preview pixels, or editor boxes
Every violation identifies page, position assignment, stable scene element, and violated boundary or corner reason
Nested groups, text bounds, paths, images, QR geometry, and overlay children participate in validation
Known rounded-corner intersections are detected rather than approximated only by an axis-aligned rectangle
Equivalent normalized scenes produce identical ordered violations
Validation diagnostics make no physical-containment or printing claim

steps.details: Add a serializable violation with stable page, assignment, position, element path/identity, geometric reason, and referenced SafeRegionResult identity.
Walk scene groups in stable order, resolve transformed element geometry, and compare supported text/path/image/QR bounds against straight and rounded region segments.
Emit one deterministic violation per offending element/reason without clipping, dropping, or mutating printable scene nodes.
Cover square, rounded-corner, nested, overlay, tangent, outside-edge, multiple-assignment, and repeated-run ordering fixtures.

technicalNotes: Keep this under ten minutes by validating existing scene primitives through their established application-owned bounds contracts.
A clean software validation result only means geometry fits the requested model; it does not prove ink will land inside a physical label.
